title: Single-limit source comparison on a chosen Ext presentation
statement: For exact additive F:A→B between abelian categories with the required derived categories and tower limits, P in A, strict B-systems S,H, a chosen ExtDerivedPresentation p for S,H, s:F(P)≅lim(S), and a normalized derived-limit model L, extSourceComparison is diagonalSingleLimitComparison(F,L,P,S,p.K,s,p.source). The structures are shared before specializing to supported sheaves.

lean.statement:
def extSourceComparison
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (P : A) {S H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B}
    (p : ExtDerivedPresentation S H) (s : F.obj P ≅ limit S) (L : DiagonalRlim B)
